Mikrotik CCR2216-1G-12XS-2XQ – High-Performance 100G Ethernet Router

The Mikrotik CCR2216-1G-12XS-2XQ is a powerful and high-performance Ethernet router designed for enterprise networking, data centers, and ISP applications. Powered by a 16-core AL73400 processor with a 2000 MHz clock speed and 16 GB RAM, this router delivers exceptional speed and efficiency.

Features & Specifications:

  • Powerful Performance – Built with an ARM 64-bit architecture and RouterOS v7 for optimized performance.
  • Ultra-Fast Connectivity – Includes 12× 25G SFP28 ports and 2× 100G QSFP28 ports, ensuring high-speed data transfers.
  • Reliable Power Supply – Dual AC inputs (100-240V) and two PSU slots for redundancy and uninterrupted operation.
  • Efficient Cooling System – Features 4 cooling fans to maintain optimal temperature for continuous performance.
  • Advanced Security – Equipped with IPsec hardware acceleration for secure data encryption.
  • Durable & Certified – CE, EAC, and ROHS-certified with a MTBF of approximately 200,000 hours at 25°C.

Designed for High-Demand Networks

With its RJ45 serial console port, two M.2 slots, and extensive monitoring capabilities (CPU & PCB temperature, voltage monitoring), the Mikrotik CCR2216 is an excellent choice for businesses requiring a high-capacity and scalable networking solution.

  • Dimensions: 443 x 367 x 44 mm
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to 60°C
